links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to endodontic pain questions (SMOG, Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: ChatGPT 3.5 required a higher reading level (SMOG 14-17.6) than Gemini (8.7-11.3, P < .001); Gemini's responses were at 6th-7th grade level but lacked depth and completeness.
links.quote: However, it required a higher reading level (Simple Measure of Gobbledygook: 14-17.6) compared to Gemini (8.7-11.3, P < .001).

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT-3.5 and Gemini responding to 62 patient questions about endodontic pain, evaluating quality, reliability, and readability without testing a specific deployment practice.
